## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (1)
- `POST /i/api/session/refresh` — Refresh the current session.

### Data Read (11)
- `GET /i/api/account/dataSharing/v1/optOut` — Check data sharing opt-out status.
- `GET /i/api/priceprediction/cars/v1/getMinPricePrediction` — Get car rental price predictions.
- `GET /i/api/trips/trip/v1/allUpcomingSimplifiedTrips` — Get all upcoming simplified trips.
- `GET /i/api/trips/user/v1/currentUser` — Get current user's trip information.
- `GET /i/api/trips/wishlist/v1/summaries` — Get wishlist summaries.
- `GET /mvm/p13n/flight/destinations` — Retrieve popular flight destinations.
- `GET /notifications` — Fetch notifications.
- `GET /s/horizon/common/personalization/Usp` — Fetch user personalization settings.
- `GET /s/horizon/common/privacy/providers/CookiesDataProvider` — Get cookie data provider information.
- `GET /s/horizon/react/component/{componentId}` — Get a specific React component.
- `GET /s/run/fpc/context` — Get flight pricing context.

### Data Write (3)
- `POST /i/api/dynamicfrontdoor/v1/trendingDestinations/{trendingDestinationId}` — Update trending destination data.
- `POST /s/run/perf` — Submit performance data.
- `POST /s/vestigo/measure` — Submit performance measurement data.

### Search (2)
- `POST /a/api/smarty/nearby` — Find nearby locations.
- `POST /s/horizon/flights/common/GetFlightSearchHistoryAction` — Get flight search history.

### Core API (2)
- `GET /i/api/{apiId}/v1/{v1Id}` — Access a core Kayak API.
- `POST /i/api/dynamicfrontdoor/v1/{v1Id}` — Access a dynamic frontdoor API.

```typescript
    console.log("Popular Destinations:", destinations);
    return destinations;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error fetching destinations:", error);
    return null;
  }
}
```

```typescript
    console.error("Error submitting performance data:", error);
    return null;

}
```

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Kayak's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Kayak data without official API access
- Automate actions on www.kayak.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Kayak frontend uses
